channel.title: Eswatini - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Eswatini, every source cited.

item.title: Eswatini fuel prices surge 51.2% since April
item.description: The Ministry of Economic Planning and Development warns of increased production costs and weakened export competitiveness.

item.title: Highlanders and Swallows clash in PLE Charity Cup
item.description: The two Mbabane rivals meet for the PLE Charity Cup just 60 days after Highlanders won their last encounter 4-0.

item.title: Eswatini sprinter Mahlalela wins two top awards
item.description: Bongiwe Mahlalela received Sportswoman of the Year and International Participation awards, earning E10,000 and a vacation.

item.title: Eswatini government seeks E3.79 billion in loans
item.description: The Ministry of Finance tabled three loan bills in the House of Assembly to finance development projects.
